name: P0: the tab click takes the first .mb-release-art-sec in the page
why: org/image-handling.org P0. A foreign detail head's picture section shares the class without data-mb-art-ctx. A bare query finds it before the archive section, sees no loaded state and lets the tab navigate instead of opening the viewer.

name: P0: _artSectionFind() without a key ignores the tab flag
why: Without the adapter's `tab` test any marked section would do; with only archive sections on a MusicBrainz page that is the same section, so the spec cannot tell. Recorded as an overlap: it matters once a non-archive adapter (P1) builds a marked section on the same page.

why: The section must load through desc.load(); a section that never loads keeps its Loading note, and openRelease() waits for data-mb-art-state="ok" in vain.
